+func cacheTLS(ctx context.Context, client *dagger.Client, base, flipt *dagger.Container, conf testConfig) func() error {
+	caCert, serverCert, serverKey, err := redisTLSCertificates()
+	if err != nil {
+		return func() error { return err }
+	}
+	redis := client.Container().
+		From("redis:alpine").
+		WithNewFile("/tls/ca.crt", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: caCert}).
+		WithNewFile("/tls/server.crt", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: serverCert}).
+		WithNewFile("/tls/server.key", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: serverKey}).
+		WithExposedPort(6379).
+		WithExec([]string{"redis-server", "--port", "0", "--tls-port", "6379", "--tls-cert-file", "/tls/server.crt", "--tls-key-file", "/tls/server.key", "--tls-ca-cert-file", "/tls/ca.crt", "--tls-auth-clients", "no"}).
+		AsService()
+
+	flipt = flipt.
+		WithServiceBinding("redis", redis).
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL", "DEBUG").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_ENABLED", "true").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_BACKEND", "redis").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_HOST", "redis").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_PORT", "6379").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_REQUIRE_TLS", "true").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_CA_CERT_BYTES", caCert)
+
+	return suite(ctx, "api", base, flipt.WithExec(nil), conf)
+}
+
+func redisTLSCertificates() (caCert, serverCert, serverKey string, err error) {
+	caKey, err := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", "", "", err
+	}
+	caTemplate := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(1),
+		NotBefore:             time.Now().Add(-time.Minute),
+		NotAfter:              time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
+		IsCA:                  true,
+		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
+		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageCertSign | x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature,
+	}
+	caDER, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, caTemplate, caTemplate, &caKey.PublicKey, caKey)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", "", "", err
+	}
+	serverPrivateKey, err := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", "", "", err
+	}
+	serverTemplate := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber: big.NewInt(2),
+		NotBefore:    time.Now().Add(-time.Minute),
+		NotAfter:     time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
+		DNSNames:     []string{"redis"},
+		ExtKeyUsage:  []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageServerAuth},
+		KeyUsage:     x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature,
+	}
+	serverDER, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, serverTemplate, caTemplate, &serverPrivateKey.PublicKey, caKey)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", "", "", err
+	}
+	encode := func(kind string, der []byte) string {
+		return string(pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: kind, Bytes: der}))
+	}
+	return encode("CERTIFICATE", caDER), encode("CERTIFICATE", serverDER), encode("RSA PRIVATE KEY", x509.MarshalPKCS1PrivateKey(serverPrivateKey)), nil
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@
+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+
+	goredis "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+// NewClient constructs a Redis client using the provided configuration.
+func NewClient(cfg config.RedisCacheConfig) (*goredis.Client, error) {
+	if cfg.CaCertPath != "" && cfg.CaCertBytes != "" {
+		return nil, errors.New("please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path")
+	}
+
+	var tlsConfig *tls.Config
+	if cfg.RequireTLS {
+		tlsConfig = &tls.Config{
+			MinVersion:         tls.VersionTLS12,
+			InsecureSkipVerify: cfg.InsecureSkipTLS,
+		}
+
+		if !cfg.InsecureSkipTLS && (cfg.CaCertPath != "" || cfg.CaCertBytes != "") {
+			certData := []byte(cfg.CaCertBytes)
+			if cfg.CaCertPath != "" {
+				var err error
+				certData, err = os.ReadFile(cfg.CaCertPath)
+				if err != nil {
+					return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading redis CA certificate: %w", err)
+				}
+			}
+
+			roots := x509.NewCertPool()
+			if ok := roots.AppendCertsFromPEM(certData); !ok {
+				return nil, errors.New("parsing redis CA certificate: no valid certificates found")
+			}
+			tlsConfig.RootCAs = roots
+		}
+	}
+
+	return goredis.NewClient(&goredis.Options{
+		Addr:            fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", cfg.Host, cfg.Port),
+		TLSConfig:       tlsConfig,
+		Username:        cfg.Username,
+		Password:        cfg.Password,
+		DB:              cfg.DB,
+		PoolSize:        cfg.PoolSize,
+		MinIdleConns:    cfg.MinIdleConn,
+		ConnMaxIdleTime: cfg.ConnMaxIdleTime,
+		DialTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout,
+		ReadTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		WriteTimeout:    cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		PoolTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+	}), nil
+}
